in_marathi.name: Divyanshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyanshi is a Sanskrit name that means 'divine girl'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'divy' (divine) and 'anshi' (girl). Divyanshi is a name that evokes a sense of purity, divinity, and grace.
